def test_report_accuracy():
        """Verify report counts match actual sanitizations."""
        with open("/app/security_report.json", "r") as f:
            report = json.load(f)
    
        with open("/app/application.log", "r") as f:
            original = f.read()
    
        with open("/app/sanitized.log", "r") as f:
            sanitized = f.read()
    
        # Count passwords in original (case-insensitive)
        password_matches = re.findall(r'password[=:\s]+([^\s\]]+)', original, re.IGNORECASE)
        password_matches += re.findall(r'"password":\s*"([^"]+)"', original, re.IGNORECASE)
        password_matches += re.findall(r"'password':\s*'([^']+)'", original, re.IGNORECASE)
    
        # Count API keys in original
        aws_keys = re.findall(r'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}', original)
    
        # Count emails in original
        emails = re.findall(r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b', original)
    
        # The report should have at least these counts (some might be filtered out)
        assert report['passwords_redacted'] >= len(password_matches), \
            f"Report shows {report['passwords_redacted']} passwords, but found {len(password_matches)} in original"
    
        assert report['api_keys_redacted'] >= len(aws_keys), \
            f"Report shows {report['api_keys_redacted']} API keys, but found {len(aws_keys)} in original"
